title: CXMT targets higher-value DRAM market with AI server memory, LPDDR6 breakthroughs
html:
Chinese DRAM maker ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) is expanding into higher-value memory markets, introducing DDR5 server modules, mass-produced LPDDR6 chips, and automotive DRAM at IC China 2026, which opened on November 12...
